notes.subject: belen
notes.rationale: פתה means 'entice/persuade' (often seduce or deceive); KJV 'allure', JPS 'allure… tenderly' — a word of both wooing and trickery.

notes.subject: kuma a dusukun na
notes.rationale: על לב 'speak upon the heart' is Hebrew for comforting, wooing speech; literal 'upon heart' would mislead.

notes.subject: על
notes.rationale: The preposition על is absorbed into 'dusukun na' (upon the heart); nothing stands alone for it.

translation: O la, aw ye a ye: ne de bɛna a belen, n bɛna a ta a taa kɛnɛma la, n bɛna kuma a dusukun na.

tokens.gloss: n bɛna a ta a taa
